scope: Internal seven-page Rosen diagnostic at source-v60; copyrighted material and translations are not published.

findings: Four original inference separators on physical pages104-105 were not represented; the premise/conclusion rows were flattened.
Two complete exercise subitems on physical page106 were fragmented and their final phrases were misclassified as sidebars, producing invented rounded boxes and a broken page continuation.
One table caption was centered over the full text area instead of its narrower table.
A definition background from the original design was not represented.
Some justified mathematical lines had excessive spacing. No Chinese clipping or cross-column overwrite was observed at the inspected scale.

limitation: Accepted translation rows and pixel equality to existing source assets did not detect omitted original vectors or incorrect source roles. These visual findings remain blockers. This diagnostic is not a public comparative benchmark.
